interpretation: As a representation of S3(row) x S3(shared) x S3(col), eta-space decomposes as (1+2)_row x 2_shared x (1+2)_col = 2 + 4 + 4 + 8. The four AlphaTensor identities are not confined to a single low-dimensional orbit-average block; their projections are nonzero across all four isotypic pieces.
